newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish banks make no comment on merger rumours.
newsitem.headline: Swedish banks make no comment on merger rumours.

text.p: Sweden's two largest banks S-E-Banken and Handelsbanken, were making no comment on Monday after a weekend newspaper report said they were in talks over a possible merger.
Business daily Dagens Industri on Saturday said the heads of the two banks had met several times in recent weeks over "tentative" talks about a possible merger.
"We do not on principle comment on rumours or speculation," S-E-Banken spokeswoman Annika Halldin told Reuters.
A spokesman from Handelsbanken said the bank would not comment on the press report.
"This is a rumour and we never comment on rumours," said spokesman Leif Lundberg.
Head of information at Stockholm's stock exchange, Hans Edenhammar, said the exchange would not be making any further inquiries into the report.
"We have had some information but we don't see any reason to ask for more," he told Reuters.
He declined to say where the information had come from.
After one hour of trade, S-E-Banken shares were 0.50 crowns higher at 59.50 crowns and Handelsbanken shares were four crowns higher at 158.5 crowns.
